schema_note: FM5 v50 writes two uint16 root fields followed by zones. FH2's v50 reader instead expects five uint32 fields and additional tables. Equal FPVS version numbers do not establish format compatibility.
world_note: Source fields and native row-vector transforms are preserved. Opaque flags, reference triples and zone uint16 data are decoded structurally, not assigned speculative semantics. FH2 root, zone dependencies, material overrides and collision still need wiring.
quality_note: FH2 native RVA 0x1340F9D constructs type-5 keys as 0x05000000 + (descriptor_index << 4) + (streaming_level - 1). ChunkMap records are uint24 resource ID plus uint8 type, not uint16 ID plus a quality byte. Resident STex blobs are a separate level, not interchangeable with streamed payloads.
descriptor_note: FH2 version >=50 serializes the source hash and trailing 52 bytes, excluding FM5's second uint32 and four floats. These 56-byte records are not a complete FH2 PVS root.
